mapper.sql: id, event_id, exchange_name, routing_key, message_type, biz_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error, published_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message_outbox (event_id, exchange_name, routing_key, message_type, biz_key, payload_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error, published_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{messageType}, #{bizKey}, #{payloadJson, typeHandler=com.group4.kaoyan.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{status}, 0, #{nextRetryAt}, NULL, NULL, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_message_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHING', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
UPDATE sys_message_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'

UPDATE sys_message_outbox SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{error}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'
UPDATE sys_message_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'
UPDATE sys_message_outbox SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_retry_at = NOW(), last_error = 'PUBLISHING 超时，已复位', update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'PUBLISHING' AND update_time < #{staleBefore}
